name: dreamy-barbie-pink-birthday-celebration
image_purpose: Birthday social content and celebration portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic pink birthday celebration portrait with a cheerful approved adult subject, cake, balloons, and soft party lighting.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long straight blonde hair and soft glam makeup, smiling widely while holding a pastel pink heart-shaped birthday cake. She wears a secure opaque pink heart-print party outfit with a modest neckline, a silver choker, and a fluffy pink birthday tiara.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait-oriented eye-level framing with the subject centered, cake held toward camera, pink and metallic balloons filling the room, heart and star balloon shapes, white strings, cream plush cushion, dining chairs, and a simple celebratory birthday banner with clean legible text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft indoor ceiling light with ambient fairy-light glow, flattering but natural face illumination, festive pink reflections, and a joyful birthday atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical social portrait, sharp subject with gently softened background, realistic cake frosting and balloon reflections, natural skin texture, soft party-glam color grading.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A dreamy photorealistic vertical birthday portrait of one approved adult woman with long straight blonde hair and soft glam makeup, smiling widely while holding a pastel pink heart-shaped birthday cake. She wears a secure opaque pink heart-print party outfit with a modest neckline, silver choker, and fluffy pink birthday tiara. Pink, hot-pink, and metallic balloons fill the indoor party room, including heart and star shapes with white strings, cream plush cushion, dining chairs, fairy lights, and a clean birthday banner. Warm soft indoor light, festive ambient glow, natural skin texture, realistic cake and balloon detail, joyful pink soft-glam atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent fabric, exposed nipples, sexualized pose, childlike appearance, distorted hands, extra fingers, unreadable cake text, random logos, watermark, plastic skin, overprocessed beauty filter, low resolution, blur
